metadata.title: Backwards compatibility is broken between 1.9.1 and nightly for `torch.cosine_similarity`

bug_description:
## 🐛 Bug







The function `torch.cosine_similarity` allowed tensor input of differing shapes in torch 1.9.1. In the nightly version for 1.10, this does not seem to be allowed anymore. This breaks backwards compatibility - is this intended here?

trigger_conditions.condition: Calling tensor operators with input tensors having incompatible ranks or dimension structures, such as passing tensors with different numbers of dimensions to torch.cosine_similarity.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Calling torch.cosine_similarity with two input tensors that have different numbers of dimensions, e.g., x1 shape [10, 2, 3, 4] and x2 shape [2, 3, 4], dim=-1.

failure_behavior.description: Calling torch.cosine_similarity with two input tensors that have different numbers of dimensions, e.g., x1 shape [10, 2, 3, 4] and x2 shape [2, 3, 4], dim=-1.
